norway_iceland.scope: Travel-scope candidate discovery, not publication-ready destination content. Exhaustive official park and Norwegian scenic route sets; broad non-finite nature-destination candidate set. Distinct nested travel identities retained; coextensive labels collapsed. No AI generation endpoints used.

mainland.finding: English national park inventory lists 40 mainland parks; add Østmarka from Norwegian official page (2023). Statistics Norway reports 41. Visit Norway promotional page still says 47 total and is stale.

svalbard.renamed: Van Mijenfjorden supersedes Nordenskiöld Land; no duplicate old-name park.

iceland.finding: Skaftafell and Jökulsárgljúfur retained only as park_sector tourism records, never current separate national parks. Legacy UST fetch returned almost no text; search result and successor Nattura confirm three.

exclusions: Tiny protected reserves without distinct travel identity
Former Gressåmoen National Park: merged into Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella
Former Øvre Anárjohka naming: same current Anárjohka identity
Former Nordenskiöld Land National Park: renamed/expanded Van Mijenfjorden
Former Skaftafell and Jökulsárgljúfur park pages as standalone current parks
Rallarvegen is a cycling route, not a scenic drive
Snæfellsnes scenic circuit represented by peninsula identity, not duplicate

field_conventions.region: Norwegian current county slugs where known; Iceland tourism regions. Null means unresolved; also_regions intentionally conservative, not exhaustive boundary coverage.
field_conventions.access: foot means destination exploration, not absence of road to gateway; null means unverified; no remote park labelled road.
field_conventions.wikidata_lat_lng: All null: native Wikipedia API refused HTTP 403; identifiers and coordinates not guessed.
field_conventions.enwiki: true only where destination link matched a fetched reference; null otherwise.
field_conventions.identity_status: unverified_individual_reference_requires_review means URL is a candidate, not a validated fetched article; must verify before handoff publication.

unresolved_issues: Candidate set outside mandatory inventories is broad but not provably exhaustive; no authoritative finite inventory of all hiking hubs/fjords exists.
Many individually constructed Wikipedia URLs have not been fetched; those rows are explicitly flagged and are not verified identity evidence.
QIDs and coordinates remain null because native API returned HTTP 403.
Cross-county also_regions and route counties remain incomplete.
Most non-park official_site values remain null; authoritative destination-level source enrichment still required.
Iceland volcanic-area closures, highland F-road access, Svalbard landing rules, and ferry requirements need current per-destination checks.
General nature_region classification includes some waterfalls and glaciers; normalize taxonomy before importing.

denmark.scope: Denmark proper plus separately flagged fo/gl territories; scenic candidates explicitly marked, not all individually verified. Null QIDs/coordinates/enwiki mean unverified.

nature_parks.caveat: Inventory mixes recognized and pilot parks. Nordals image alt says pilot although heading says Naturpark; verify certification before publication. May 2025 council news certifies Sønder Lem Vig and Tryggevælde Ådal; former Flyndersø name must be reconciled, not blindly counted twice.

denmark.schema_notes: country=dk is realm catalog membership; territory uses ISO dk/fo/gl and must control routing/access. Mainland five parks exclude Greenland national park. Scenic coverage is broad but not exhaustive; candidates require source validation.
